mapper.insert: insert into employee( employee_no, account_no, employee_type, employee_htime ) values( #{employeeNo}, #{accountNo}, #{employeeType}, #{employeeHtime} )
mapper.select: select a.account_no, a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_phone, a.account_status, a.account_type, e.employee_no, e.employee_type, e.employee_htime from account A join employee e on a.account_no = e.account_no where a.account_id = #{accountId} and a.account_type = '직원'
